title: State Mandated ADU Height Allowance Near Transit
audit_text: State law mandates that a local agency must allow an 18-foot height limit for a detached ADU on a lot within one-half mile of a major transit stop.

title: Prohibition of Minimum Parking Mandates
audit_text: Public agencies are barred from imposing minimum parking standards on residential or commercial developments within one-half mile of a major transit stop.

title: Ministerial ADU Approval Within 60 Days
audit_text: A local agency shall approve or deny a complete ADU application ministerially, without discretionary review or a hearing, within 60 days.

title: Objective ADU Standards: Size, Setbacks, Design
audit_text: Local standards must be objective. Side and rear setbacks may not exceed 4 feet; a detached ADU up to 1,200 sq ft must be allowed.

title: Ministerial Small-Lot Subdivisions (10 Units or Fewer)
audit_text: Qualifying projects of 10 or fewer units on multifamily-zoned lots of 5 acres or less must be approved ministerially, without a hearing.

title: Streamlined Ministerial Approval for Affordable Projects
audit_text: Projects that meet objective standards and affordability thresholds in jurisdictions behind on RHNA qualify for streamlined ministerial review. Excludes very-high fire hazard zones and coastal areas.
